_comment: Basic subagent-spawn plumbing on the flat reason-act loop (no planning). turn:1 spawns a subagent via nested scripted_model_responses (turn_id <turn:1>:sub:1), folds its result back on the next step, then ends. Guards the caller_is_subagent NameError that once crashed ModelCall for ANY spawn.
